source_instruction: i am looking for camo colored women's running shorts with an elastic waistband.
query:
Ugh, I swear the community garden plot I signed up for back in spring is testing every last bit of my patience this week. I showed up yesterday morning thinking I’d just pluck a few ripe cherry tomatoes and pull the scraggly weeds that popped up after last week’s random thunderstorm, only to find that a family of squirrels had chewed through half my sunflower stalks and dug up the three zinnia seedlings I’d babied for two months after starting them on my fire escape. I stood there for a solid ten minutes holding my little trowel just staring at the mess, watching one of the squirrels perch on the split-rail fence like it owned the place, munching on a sunflower seed it had definitely stolen from my plot. I even brought a little container of the homemade lemon poppyseed muffins I baked on Sunday to share with the other regular garden folks, and I was so flustered I left the whole container sitting on the park bench on my walk home, so I didn’t even get a snack to make the whole frustrating morning worth it.
Hey, can you help me pick something out from the women’s activewear section? I’m looking for pieces with a rubberized drawstring waistband, and I’d also love options that come with a matching detachable water bottle holder, all under $30. I don’t have a super specific look I’m going for as long as it fits well for my weekend walks, just pull whatever fits those other marks and I’ll sort through the options.

extras.text: come with a matching detachable water bottle holder
